q: how much is the late payment fee
expect_answer: 2% of the overdue balance, minimum $5, maximum $25 per bill.

q: when does a late payment charge apply
expect_answer: When the full balance is not received by the due date.

q: is there a grace period for late payments
expect_answer: No late charge if payment arrives within two business days after the due date.

q: can I set up a payment arrangement
expect_answer: Ask an agent before the due date; arrangements are set up only by an agent.

q: when is my bill payment due
expect_answer: 21 days after the bill is issued.

q: how can I pay my bill
expect_answer: Pre-authorized debit, credit card, online banking, or in a Tessaline store.

q: how long does an online banking payment take
expect_answer: Up to three business days.

q: can I get a paper bill
expect_answer: Free for customers 65+ or on a disability benefit; otherwise $2 per month.

q: when does my bill cycle start
expect_answer: The same day every month; the bill covers the next month in advance.

q: what is a prorated charge
expect_answer: A partial charge or credit for the days each plan was active after a mid-cycle change.

q: why can the bill after a plan change be higher
expect_answer: It can include the prorated charge plus the full monthly charge for the new cycle.

q: how is proration calculated
expect_answer: Monthly price divided by days in the cycle, times the days the plan was active.

q: how much data does the Essential plan have
expect_answer: 20 GB for $45 per month.

q: how much is the Unlimited plan
expect_answer: $80 per month with 150 GB at full speed.

q: what happens when I use all my data on Plus
expect_answer: Speed is reduced to 512 kbps; there is no overage charge.

q: are there overage charges for data
expect_answer: No overage charge; speed is reduced after the monthly amount.

q: how fast is home internet
expect_answer: 500 Mbps for $70 or 1 Gbps for $90 per month, unlimited usage.

q: do I have to return the modem
expect_answer: Yes, the included modem must be returned when service ends.

q: is there a discount for mobile and internet together
expect_answer: A $10 monthly discount on the home internet plan.

q: how much is roaming in the US
expect_answer: Travel Pass is $12 per day in the United States.

q: how much does Travel Pass cost in Europe
expect_answer: $16 per day in countries other than the United States.

q: is there a cap on Travel Pass charges
expect_answer: Charges stop after 10 days in the same bill cycle.

q: does wifi calling abroad trigger Travel Pass
expect_answer: No, Wi-Fi calling and messaging do not trigger Travel Pass.

q: do I get a credit for an outage
expect_answer: If service is unavailable more than 24 consecutive hours from a network outage.

q: do I need to ask for an outage credit
expect_answer: No, credits are applied automatically for confirmed network outages.

q: how often are outage estimates updated
expect_answer: At least every two hours.

q: what are the appointment windows
expect_answer: 8 am to 12 pm, 12 pm to 4 pm, or 4 pm to 8 pm.

q: what does on hold mean for a ticket
expect_answer: Parts or access are needed before work can continue.

q: how soon is a repair scheduled for a full outage
expect_answer: Within two business days.

q: what do I need to verify my identity
expect_answer: The account number and the postal code of the service address.
